/-- A local quadratic upper bound plus continuity rules out leaving the local
Lyapunov sublevel before the end of a sufficiently short line segment. The
bound is assumed only where the Lyapunov value is already local. -/
theorem continuous_local_quadratic_bound_bootstraps_the_endpoint
    (V : ℝ → ℝ) (delta c : ℝ) (hdelta : 0 < delta) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hsmall : c ≤ delta) (hcontinuous : ContinuousOn V (Icc 0 1))
    (hzero : V 0 = 0)
    (hlocal : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 1, V t ≤ delta → V t ≤ c * t ^ 2) :
    V 1 ≤ c := by
  have hendpoint : V 1 ≤ delta := by
    by_contra hnot
    have habove : delta < V 1 := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    obtain ⟨t, ht, heq⟩ := intermediate_value_Ioo (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num)
      hcontinuous (show delta ∈ Ioo (V 0) (V 1) by simpa [hzero] using And.intro hdelta habove)
    have hbound := hlocal t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩ (by simpa [heq])
    have hsq : t ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith [ht.1, ht.2]
    have hmult : c * t ^ 2 ≤ delta * t ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall (sq_nonneg t)
    have hstrict : delta * t ^ 2 < delta := by nlinarith
    rw [heq] at hbound
    linarith
  simpa using hlocal 1 (by norm_num) hendpoint

end SafeLearning.CompleteCoreMPCLocalBootstrap27

namespace SafeLearning.CompleteCoreMPCLocalBootstrap27

theorem continuous_local_quadratic_state_bound_bootstraps_small_state_error
    {S : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup S] [NormedSpace ℝ S]
    (X : Set S) (hX : Convex ℝ X) (V : S → ℝ) (z x : S)
    (hz : z ∈ X) (hx : x ∈ X) (delta cU : ℝ)
    (hdelta : 0 < delta) (hcU : 0 ≤ cU)
    (hsmall : cU * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2 ≤ delta)
    (hcontinuous : ContinuousOn V X) (hzero : V z = 0)
    (hlocal : ∀ y ∈ X, V y ≤ delta → V y ≤ cU * ‖y - z‖ ^ 2) :
    V x ≤ cU * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2 := by
  let path : ℝ → S := fun t => z + t • (x - z)
  have hpath : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 1, path t ∈ X := by
    intro t ht
    exact hX.add_smul_sub_mem hz hx ht
  have hpcontinuous : Continuous path :=
    continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
  have hvcontinuous : ContinuousOn (fun t => V (path t)) (Icc 0 1) :=
    hcontinuous.comp hpcontinuous.continuousOn hpath
  have hpzero : path 0 = z := by simp [path]
  have hpone : path 1 = x := by simp [path]
  have hbound := continuous_local_quadratic_bound_bootstraps_the_endpoint
    (fun t => V (path t)) delta (cU * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) hdelta
    (mul_nonneg hcU (sq_nonneg _)) hsmall hvcontinuous (by simpa [hpzero] using hzero)
    (by
      intro t ht hvalue
      have hh := hlocal (path t) (hpath t ht) hvalue
      have hpnorm : ‖path t - z‖ = t * ‖x - z‖ := by
        simp only [path, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
      rw [hpnorm] at hh
      convert hh using 1 <;> ring)
  simpa [hpone] using hbound

end SafeLearning.CompleteCoreMPCLocalBootstrap27

namespace SafeLearning.CompleteCoreMPCLocalBootstrap27

def polytopicStateSet {S J : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup S] [NormedSpace ℝ S]
    (rows : J → S →L[ℝ] ℝ) (margin : ℝ) : Set S :=
  {state | ∀ j, rows j state ≤ 1 - margin}

theorem actual_linear_constraint_margin_covers_every_bounded_state_perturbation
    {S J : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup S] [NormedSpace ℝ S]
    (rows : J → S →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z x : S) (H radius margin : ℝ)
    (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hrows : ∀ j, ‖rows j‖ ≤ H)
    (hz : z ∈ polytopicStateSet rows margin)
    (herror : ‖x - z‖ ≤ radius) (hmargin : H * radius ≤ margin) :
    x ∈ polytopicStateSet rows 0 := by
  intro j
  have hlinear : rows j x = rows j z + rows j (x - z) := by
    rw [map_sub]
    ring
  have hnorm := (rows j).le_opNorm (x - z)
  have hrowerror : rows j (x - z) ≤ H * radius := by
    calc
      rows j (x - z) ≤ ‖rows j (x - z)‖ := by
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using le_abs_self (rows j (x - z))
      _ ≤ ‖rows j‖ * ‖x - z‖ := hnorm
      _ ≤ H * ‖x - z‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hrows j) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ H * radius := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left herror hH
  have hnominal := hz j
  rw [hlinear]
  linarith

end SafeLearning.CompleteCoreMPCLocalBootstrap27

hypotheses: For each t in [0,1], only when V(t)<=delta, V(t)<=c*t^2
components.reason: The proof does not assume the endpoint lies in the local sublevel. If V(1)>delta, the intermediate value theorem gives 0<t<1 with V(t)=delta. The conditional local estimate and c<=delta then give delta<=c*t^2<=delta*t^2<delta, contradiction. At the endpoint the local estimate yields V(1)<=c. Positivity of delta supplies the strict inequality even at c=delta.

hypotheses: Real normed state space, convex X; both z and x belong to X
Conditional upper quadratic bound for every y in X with V(y)<=delta
components.reason: The actual path z+t*(x-z) lies in X by convexity. Composition gives continuous V along that path; its endpoints are z and x. Norm homogeneity for 0<=t<=1 transforms the local estimate into c*t^2 with c=cU*norm(x-z)^2. The first-crossing theorem therefore proves the small-error endpoint estimate without assuming V(x)<=delta.

hypotheses: Rows are real continuous linear functionals on the chosen normed state space
H>=0 and every row operator norm<=H
components.reason: Actual linearity writes row(x)=row(z)+row(x-z). The continuous-linear-map operator bound controls the latter term by H*norm(x-z)<=H*radius. Nominal tightening plus the margin inequality then proves every actual row(x)<=1. The generic theorem does not silently substitute a coordinate sup norm for the chosen state norm.

Definition — The robust-design assumptions of Hertneck et al. (2018, Assumptions 1–4 and eq. 9)
        Assumption 1 (local incremental stabilisability). There are a feedback $\kappa(x,z,v)$, a $\delta$-Lyapunov function $V_\delta(x,z,v)\ge0$ with $V_\delta(z,z,v)=0$, and constants $c_{\delta,l},c_{\delta,u},\delta_{\rm loc},k_{\max}\gt0$, $\rho\in(0,1)$ such that, whenever $V_\delta(x,z,v)\le\delta_{\rm loc}$,
        $$c_{\delta,l}\|x-z\|^2\le V_\delta(x,z,v)\le c_{\delta,u}\|x-z\|^2,\qquad\|\kappa(x,z,v)-v\|\le k_{\max}\|x-z\|,\qquad V_\delta(x^+,z^+,v^+)\le\rho\,V_\delta(x,z,v),$$
        with $x^+=f(x,\kappa(x,z,v))$ and $z^+=f(z,v)$: a feedback that lets the true state $x$ track a nominal trajectory $z$ driven by inputs $v$, the squared tracking error shrinking by the factor $\rho$ per step.
        Assumption 2. $\|f(x,u+d)-f(x,u)\|\le\lambda\|d\|_\infty$ for $x\in X$ and $u,\,u+d\in U$.
        Assumption 3. $\eta\le\lambda^{-1}\sqrt{\delta_{\rm loc}/c_{\delta,u}}$.
        Tightening (eq. 9). With $X=\{x:Hx\le\mathbf 1\}$ and $U_t=\{u:L_tu\le\mathbf 1\}$: $\epsilon:=\eta\lambda\sqrt{c_{\delta,u}/c_{\delta,l}}\,\max\{\|H\|_\infty,\|L_t\|_\infty k_{\max}\}$ and $\epsilon_k=\epsilon\sum_{j=0}^{k-1}\sqrt\rho^{\,j}$.
        Assumption 4 (terminal set). $V_f(x)=x^\top Px$, $X_f=\{V_f\le\alpha_f\}$ and a controller $k_f$ with, for all $x\in X_f$: $f(x,k_f(x))+w\in X_f$ for every $\|w\|\le\lambda\eta\sqrt{\rho^Nc_{\delta,u}/c_{\delta,l}}$; $V_f(f(x,k_f(x)))\le V_f(x)-\big(x^\top Qx+k_f(x)^\top Rk_f(x)\big)$; $(x,k_f(x))\in\bar X_N\times\bar U_N$.
        In words. An input error $\|d\|_\infty\le\eta$ moves the next state by at most $\lambda\eta$ (Assumption 2), so the re-planned trajectory starts within $V_\delta\le c_{\delta,u}\lambda^2\eta^2\le\delta_{\rm loc}$ of the old plan: Assumption 3 is exactly what keeps this inside the region where the tracking certificate holds. Afterwards $\sqrt{V_\delta}$ shrinks by $\sqrt\rho$ per step, so $k$ steps later the state is within $\sqrt\rho^{\,k}\lambda\eta\sqrt{c_{\delta,u}/c_{\delta,l}}$ of the old plan; in constraint units (factors $\|H\|_\infty$, and $\|L_t\|_\infty k_{\max}$ for inputs) this is at most $\epsilon\sqrt\rho^{\,k}=\epsilon_{k+1}-\epsilon_k$, the increment of the tightening. What is left after $N$ steps is the ball the terminal set must absorb. All of this is checked before learning; validation only estimates how often the network stays within $\eta$.

Hertneck, Köhler, Trimpe & Allgöwer, L-CSS 2018 make the MPC tolerate the error it will later suffer: treat $\pi_{\mathrm{approx}}(x)=\pi_{\mathrm{MPC}}(x)+d$, $\|d\|_\infty\le\eta$, as an input disturbance. The robust MPC is a nominal MPC with terminal set $X_f$ and tightened constraints $\bar X_k=(1-\epsilon_k)X$, $\bar U_k=(1-\epsilon_k)U_t$, $U_t=U\ominus\{\|d\|_\infty\le\eta\}$, $\epsilon_k=\epsilon(1-\sqrt\rho^{\,k})/(1-\sqrt\rho)$ growing like a tube. Assumptions 1–4: local incremental stabilisability (a $\delta$-Lyapunov function contracting at rate $\rho\lt1$), $\|f(x,u+d)-f(x,u)\|\le\lambda\|d\|_\infty$, a bound on $\eta$, and a robustly invariant terminal set with a local control Lyapunov function. import Mathlib.Topology.Order.IntermediateValue
import Mathlib.Tactic

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Set

namespace SafeLearning.CompleteCoreMPCLocalBootstrap27

/-- A local quadratic upper bound plus continuity rules out leaving the local
Lyapunov sublevel before the end of a sufficiently short line segment. The
bound is assumed only where the Lyapunov value is already local. -/
theorem continuous_local_quadratic_bound_bootstraps_the_endpoint
    (V : ℝ → ℝ) (delta c : ℝ) (hdelta : 0 < delta) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hsmall : c ≤ delta) (hcontinuous : ContinuousOn V (Icc 0 1))
    (hzero : V 0 = 0)
    (hlocal : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 1, V t ≤ delta → V t ≤ c * t ^ 2) :
    V 1 ≤ c := by
  have hendpoint : V 1 ≤ delta := by
    by_contra hnot
    have habove : delta < V 1 := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    obtain ⟨t, ht, heq⟩ := intermediate_value_Ioo (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num)
      hcontinuous (show delta ∈ Ioo (V 0) (V 1) by simpa [hzero] using And.intro hdelta habove)
    have hbound := hlocal t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩ (by simpa [heq])
    have hsq : t ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith [ht.1, ht.2]
    have hmult : c * t ^ 2 ≤ delta * t ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall (sq_nonneg t)
    have hstrict : delta * t ^ 2 < delta := by nlinarith
    rw [heq] at hbound
    linarith
  simpa using hlocal 1 (by norm_num) hendpoint

end SafeLearning.CompleteCoreMPCLocalBootstrap27

theorem continuous_local_quadratic_state_bound_bootstraps_small_state_error
    {S : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup S] [NormedSpace ℝ S]
    (X : Set S) (hX : Convex ℝ X) (V : S → ℝ) (z x : S)
    (hz : z ∈ X) (hx : x ∈ X) (delta cU : ℝ)
    (hdelta : 0 < delta) (hcU : 0 ≤ cU)
    (hsmall : cU * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2 ≤ delta)
    (hcontinuous : ContinuousOn V X) (hzero : V z = 0)
    (hlocal : ∀ y ∈ X, V y ≤ delta → V y ≤ cU * ‖y - z‖ ^ 2) :
    V x ≤ cU * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2 := by
  let path : ℝ → S := fun t => z + t • (x - z)
  have hpath : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 1, path t ∈ X := by
    intro t ht
    exact hX.add_smul_sub_mem hz hx ht
  have hpcontinuous : Continuous path :=
    continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
  have hvcontinuous : ContinuousOn (fun t => V (path t)) (Icc 0 1) :=
    hcontinuous.comp hpcontinuous.continuousOn hpath
  have hpzero : path 0 = z := by simp [path]
  have hpone : path 1 = x := by simp [path]
  have hbound := continuous_local_quadratic_bound_bootstraps_the_endpoint
    (fun t => V (path t)) delta (cU * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) hdelta
    (mul_nonneg hcU (sq_nonneg _)) hsmall hvcontinuous (by simpa [hpzero] using hzero)
    (by
      intro t ht hvalue
      have hh := hlocal (path t) (hpath t ht) hvalue
      have hpnorm : ‖path t - z‖ = t * ‖x - z‖ := by
        simp only [path, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
      rw [hpnorm] at hh
      convert hh using 1 <;> ring)
  simpa [hpone] using hbound

end SafeLearning.CompleteCoreMPCLocalBootstrap27
